convention: The hull box reaches the hull and turret roof; sights, antennas and roof guns are dressing within 0.3 m (bulky) or 0.15 m across (thin); the pivot sits at the centre of the turret ring (a fixed howitzer mount: its trunnion); the muzzle sits at the real barrel length. Box length covers the body (hull plus any armoured turret overhang), centred on the box origin.

thresholds.note: Slice 07's guesses, kept: every fix row below clears them by a wide margin or is named as borderline. muzzle_reach_m is added by lane F-C (the slice set none for muzzles).

glacis.reading: The BMP-3 hull's nose is high and blunt: a short, steep lower plate (about 60 deg) under a long, shallow upper glacis carrying the trim vane. The model's nose is 0.45 m low, which makes its upper glacis dive and its lower plate lie nearly flat: the user's note.

verdicts.why: 7.14 m on the BMP-3 hull (S13); 7.02 m published is 1.7 % off.
3.2 m against 3.28 m over the fenders: 0.08 m, inside 0.10 m.
2.57 m is to the turret's fixed fittings; the art's roof is 2.30 m and the BMP-3's 2.37 m. 2.4 m sits between them.
Same ring position as the BMP-3 (+0.27 m on the drawing).
